scope: Thirty new UI responsiveness and render-speed production costs after the merged prior 100. Startup/editor lazy loading, prior 74 findings, round-two 100 and correctness-only fixes excluded.
ownership: Published document/model/result collections are immutable. Caches are per mounted component or per preference snapshot, bounded by that owner; no module-global document caches. Presentation remains read-only. EQ gestures consume raw input before batching only React draft publication.

verification.staticChecks: All added/modified UI source and tests pass type-aware ESLint. npm run lint:changed passes. Full tsconfig.tests TypeScript compilation exits zero. File-size and whitespace checks pass.
verification.independentReview: DSP agent independently reviewed every retained owner and production caller, immutable publication/PCM identities and EQ gesture ownership. No defect found. An additional 10500 deterministic shortcut-index/reference comparisons retain exact conflict semantics.
verification.behavior: Exact original helper output checks, getter/work counters over 30 React publications, 500-model and shortcut catalogs, 2048 spectrum bins, 4000 owner/1000 requirement lookup fixtures, controlled RAF ownership/final-release/cancellation and nonmonotonic EQ sweep parity.
verification.timing: This register establishes distinct removed work; no per-item millisecond speedup is inferred from Node or idle RAF. Root owns Electron default Speed and browser/canonical measurements.
verification.existingCoverage: Existing shortcut row, linked Project Bin, workspace dock/header/meter, Graphic/Filter Curve EQ, model manager/result review/acceptance authority, Clip Properties, mastering and compatibility focused suites were run during development.
verification.limitations: Retained work uses current immutable ownership contracts. PCM content changes must publish new visual buffer/peak identity, and document/model/results must publish changed owning collections. These contracts are already used by editor presentation.

findings.title: Retain Project Bin linked-item grouping
findings.avoidedCost: Grouping and sorting linked clip items repeated on each transport/preview publication.
findings.evidence: Thirty preview-like React publications perform zero additional binItemId reads; grouping identity survives.
findings.limitations: Published immutable bin-clip membership owns invalidation.

findings.title: Retain Project Bin source joins
findings.avoidedCost: Rebuilding the source index and item source arrays repeated for every preview update.
findings.evidence: Thirty publications perform zero additional source-id reads and preserve joined arrays.
findings.limitations: Sources and grouped-item identities invalidate; duplicate source IDs preserve original Map last-write behavior.

findings.title: Retain Project Bin waveform SVG geometry
findings.avoidedCost: Cards rescanned peaks or PCM and regenerated SVG paths on transport updates.
findings.evidence: A 48000-sample fixture performs zero new getChannelData calls over thirty publications; path equals the original builder.
findings.limitations: PCM buffer/peaks and clip identities own invalidation; no decimation or visible geometry changes.

findings.title: Retain Project Bin transform badges
findings.avoidedCost: Repeated transform traversal, badge deduplication and array construction for unchanged card content.
findings.evidence: Thirty publications add zero gain getter reads; badges exactly equal the original transform builder.
findings.limitations: Clip/source arrays and localized copy invalidate.

findings.title: Retain Project Bin authored media timing
findings.avoidedCost: Video/generator duration and sequence conversion repeated on preview progress.
findings.evidence: Thirty publications add zero authored-duration reads; changing sequence rate changes 192000 frames to 96000.
findings.limitations: Project, clip and source identities invalidate; existing timing functions retain authority.

findings.title: Retain Project Bin localized duration labels
findings.avoidedCost: Repeated Intl.NumberFormat construction and duration formatting on card preview ticks.
findings.evidence: Intl.NumberFormat constructor proxy records zero added formatting over thirty publications; changed duration produces the original label.
findings.limitations: Duration, sample rate and locale invalidate.

findings.title: Retain Project Bin instance-count scans
findings.avoidedCost: Each card scanned document membership for its instance count during preview.
findings.evidence: Thirty publications add zero instanceCount calls.
findings.limitations: Controller count function, clip ID and timeline/bin clip collections invalidate.

findings.title: Retain workspace dock layout and arrangement model
findings.avoidedCost: Eligibility filtering, grouping, sorting, side-column derivation and arrangement target labeling repeated on unrelated publications.
findings.evidence: Thirty renders preserve the model and add zero panel visibility reads; locale and bin eligibility updates invalidate.
findings.limitations: One finding for the entire layout preparation; product capabilities, capture phase, Web VCR mode/capability, preferences, locale copy and dock invalidate.

findings.title: Prepare shortcut searchable command text
findings.avoidedCost: Every search keystroke rebuilt localized label/ID text and normalized the same query for each command.
findings.evidence: Changing query over a 500-command catalog adds zero label getter reads; output still matches the original lowercased search.
findings.limitations: Command catalog identity invalidates prepared text; query/sort changes still update groups.

findings.title: Share a canonical shortcut draft conflict index
findings.avoidedCost: Each row draft edit normalized and scanned the entire preference shortcut map.
findings.evidence: 200-action fixture performs zero added preference-map getter reads over 100 draft queries; 64 adversarial owner/reserved/legacy cases match the original validator.
findings.limitations: Invocation-local index; noncanonical IDs and reserved targets use the original validator; conflict order and Ctrl/Meta equivalence preserved.

findings.title: Admit shortcut catalog work only on its active preferences page
findings.avoidedCost: Preferences interactions on unrelated pages collected the full shortcut inventory.
findings.evidence: Inactive page adds zero menu getter reads; activating the shortcut page builds the complete original inventory.
findings.limitations: Menu-driven interaction admission only; not editor startup or lazy loading.

findings.title: Retain Graphic EQ tick geometry
findings.avoidedCost: Every gain draft recreated static dB ticks and percentage positions.
findings.evidence: Thirty renders preserve exact tick model identity; existing Graphic EQ domain fixtures preserve band behavior.
findings.limitations: Minimum and maximum gains invalidate.

findings.title: Retain Filter Curve EQ grid geometry
findings.avoidedCost: Each draft recalculated frequency candidates, spacing selection, logarithmic positions and dB ticks.
findings.evidence: Thirty renders preserve grid identity; dB viewport change invalidates the model.
findings.limitations: Viewport identity owns sample rate, frequency scale and gain bounds; original spacing/formatting math remains.

findings.title: Retain Filter Curve requested/response SVG paths
findings.avoidedCost: Repeated polyline serialization, split/Number conversion and SVG coordinate remapping for unchanged curve points.
findings.evidence: Thirty renders add zero frequency getter reads and preserve exact original path string.
findings.limitations: One count across requested and response paths; points or viewport invalidate.

findings.title: Retain FIR response frequency geometry separately from gain view
findings.avoidedCost: Changing min/max dB regenerated 257 response frequencies and triggered unchanged FIR response analysis.
findings.evidence: Gain viewport change preserves frequency-array identity; all 257 values equal the original viewport-derived values.
findings.limitations: Sample rate and linear/log frequency scale invalidate; all curve/filter parameters still invalidate the response effect.

findings.title: Coalesce EQ React draft publication to animation frames
findings.avoidedCost: Every raw pointer sample scheduled a full EQ React draft render.
findings.evidence: Three raw draft publications schedule one RAF and one React render; mounted Graphic EQ processes a nonmonotonic sweep exactly like the gesture oracle and commits final release before RAF.
findings.limitations: One finding shared across both editors; every raw sample and routed preview callback remains consumed. Foreign pointer samples, Escape, release, unmount and cancellation preserve ownership.

findings.title: Read Filter Curve pointer-press bounds once
findings.avoidedCost: A pointer press read the same DOM rectangle twice for normalized coordinates and hit testing.
findings.evidence: Mounted SVG test records exactly one getBoundingClientRect call on press and exact final-release gain.
findings.limitations: Press-time focus does not change SVG box geometry; moves retain live coordinate reads.

findings.title: Retain localized model search catalog and filtered output
findings.avoidedCost: Each download-progress render rebuilt display names, localized task strings, lowercase text and filters.
findings.evidence: 500-model fixture adds zero task getter and purpose-label calls over thirty unrelated publications; query change reuses prepared search text.
findings.limitations: Model collection, copy, locale, purpose, related filter and task/status/query inputs invalidate relevant stages.

findings.title: Retain unchanged model activity membership
findings.avoidedCost: Progress snapshots recreated busy/installing/cancelling Sets even when their freshly published sorted arrays had equal members; local input edits recreated progress lookup.
findings.evidence: Thirty fresh-array progress snapshots preserve all three Set identities while progress bytes update; membership changes rebuild correctly.
findings.limitations: Exact ordered string comparison plus a private snapshot avoids hash-Set allocation. Progress Map separately retains on local-only renders; no claim that changed progress entries skip indexing.

findings.title: Retain local model task dropdown options
findings.avoidedCost: Repeated catalog task traversal, deduplication and localization on progress.
findings.evidence: 500-model fixture preserves task option identity and adds zero task/purpose reads over thirty publications.
findings.limitations: Model collection and localized copy/purpose invalidate.

findings.title: Retain offline maintenance model choices
findings.avoidedCost: Maintenance section repeatedly filtered uninstalled installable models and constructed localized dropdown options.
findings.evidence: 500-model fixture preserves choices and option identities across thirty progress-like publications.
findings.limitations: Models and copy invalidate; actual selection lookup remains current.

findings.title: Retain assistance operation slot compatibility choices
findings.avoidedCost: Each job progress render rebuilt policy task slots and filtered every model for every slot.
findings.evidence: 500-model assistance fixture preserves choices and adds zero task reads across thirty publications.
findings.limitations: Model identity, operation and shot-detection mode invalidate; null operation retains the original one-empty-slot behavior.

findings.title: Skip unchanged deep semantic review renders
findings.avoidedCost: Progress rerenders traversed immutable transcript/semantic output trees.
findings.evidence: 1000-segment mounted output retains all 1001 list items while thirty publications add zero segment text reads.
findings.limitations: Shallow copy/outputs ownership invalidates; semantic review is read-only and existing acceptance authority remains unchanged.

findings.title: Retain assistance review identity serialization
findings.avoidedCost: View repeatedly serialized result claim identity, including duplicate calls in one render.
findings.evidence: Thirty publications add zero claimId reads; string exactly equals the original public identity function.
findings.limitations: Result identity invalidates; the public function remains exported from its original module.

findings.title: Retain Clip Properties membership and labels
findings.avoidedCost: Unrelated snapshot publications rebuilt selected-ID Set, clip/source maps and labels.
findings.evidence: Thirty fresh project wrappers with unchanged owning collections add zero clip ID reads and retain selection identity.
findings.limitations: Project ID, clip/source collections, persisted/live selection IDs and fallback label invalidate.

findings.title: Retain image property target normalization and validation
findings.avoidedCost: Each parent publication remapped document collections, searched clip/source/sequence/track and normalized the same image.
findings.evidence: Thirty publications add zero unrelated image ID reads and retain the full target.
findings.limitations: Collections, sample rate and target clip ID invalidate; validation and normalization remain exactly in the existing render path.

findings.title: Retain report spectrum SVG geometry
findings.avoidedCost: Analysis dialog rerenders repeated logarithmic bin projection and SVG serialization.
findings.evidence: 2048-bin fixture adds zero dB getter reads over thirty renders; output equals the original spectrumPlotPoints and new bins invalidate.
findings.limitations: Report bins own invalidation; no peak decimation or changed plot geometry.

findings.title: Retain mastering entry form keys
findings.avoidedCost: Picker/local rerenders repeated per-entry JSON serialization of title, duration, fades, gap and metadata.
findings.evidence: Thirty renders add zero metadata title reads and retain keys; changed entry title invalidates.
findings.limitations: Sequence ID and immutable entry collection invalidate; original form reset key bytes preserved.

findings.title: Index compatibility placeholder owner names
findings.avoidedCost: Every effect placeholder performed a collection.find across tracks/groups/sends/clips.
findings.evidence: 4000-owner fixture reads collection IDs once and adds zero owner reads for thirty repeated queries; first authored duplicate wins.
findings.limitations: Indexes built lazily only for requested scope and invalidated by owning collections; missing-owner fallback unchanged.

findings.title: Index compatibility requirements and prepare visible affected objects
findings.avoidedCost: Each requirement row searched all affected requirements and refiltered objects.
findings.evidence: 1000-requirement fixture adds zero requirement or object getter reads for thirty renders; omitted count updates invalidate.
findings.limitations: One count for requirement lookup plus its presentation filtering; first authored duplicate and attributable/omitted metadata preserved.
